summary: Bound all profiler JSONL outputs with size-based rotation and one retained predecessor.

compatibility.detail: Slow, minute, and in-flight JSONL output each retain two files capped at 8 MiB by default, for 48 MiB combined. Complete records larger than the cap and oversized legacy files are dropped. Drops are logged on stderr. Totals remain replaced separately.

manual.detail: Set ST3_PROFILE_FILE_BYTES to a positive byte limit before daemon startup to override the per-file cap. Invalid or zero values use the default. Archive older diagnostic logs before starting the updated daemon if they must be kept.

recovery.detail: Retention removes diagnostic data on append; removed logs cannot be restored without a separate archive. No application data migration or recovery is required.

downtime.detail: A normal daemon restart applies the code and configuration; restart duration has not been measured.
